title: SyncManager marks every non-definite mirror failure uncertain (sync-manager.ts:143), including the iPhone phone file's plain write error (cloud-adapters.ts:194-195, :225-226), so the mark cannot tell 'may have stored' from 'stored nothing': a trap for the next reader
evidence: Found in PR 1750 (S69 R2). The failure mirror writes through saveRecordInto (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts:51-52), so SyncManager.save marks any write failure isDefiniteRefusal does not name (sync-manager.ts:143). ios/engine/cloud-adapters.ts PhoneFileAdapter throws a plain StorageError(answer.error) for a failed read (:194-195) and a failed phoneWrite (:225-226): no status, no reason, no quota cause, so each is marked uncertain though Data.write(.atomic) leaves the old file. A mirror catch that read the mark would stop the iPhone's S57 put-back (ios/engine/cloud.test.ts:1185 fails; tried and reverted in PR 1750). PR 1750 reads the device copy's revision instead. Candidate fix (option A): a StorageFailureReason in write-refusal.ts's definite table, set by PhoneFileAdapter's text() and writeText().
